answer: A sybil farming many identities hits the inlet of entry costs: every fake node pays the full bond, and the willow-rooted reputation graph slashes stake on failed challenges, so N identities cost N bonds while legitimate peers refund cleanly. Each agent must stake a bond tied to a unique hardware root, and peers challenge newcomers to solve a rotating proof seeded by the epoch's vine hash. From Agent0180's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
